description: This file is a Node.js script that wraps the 'expo start' command, normalizing host options for various environments, sanitizing CLI arguments, setting environment variables, and spawning a child process to run the expo CLI with the configured options.

methods.name: resolveHostMode()
methods.description: Determines the host mode ('lan', 'tunnel', 'localhost') based on environment variables and defaults.

methods.name: sanitizeIncomingArgs(argv)
methods.description: Removes conflicting or invalid '--host' CLI arguments from process.argv.

methods.name: buildArgs()
methods.description: Constructs the argument list for 'expo start' including host normalization and platform flags.

methods.name: run()
methods.description: Sanitizes incoming CLI arguments, builds final arguments, and spawns the 'npx' child process to run 'expo' with the prepared arguments.
